slice_id: intraday P19 wire cash_flow_policy into DevelopmentReplay

phase0_history.design: two new OPTIONAL, paired params (cash_flow_policy, cash_flow_policy_sha256) on DevelopmentReplay, mirroring the existing REQUIRED fill_policy/fill_policy_sha256 pair, threaded through to ReplayAdapter's second constructor argument
phase0_history.finding: 0 Critical, 1 Major, 1 Minor, 1 Nit. Major: the XOR validation block skipped the type/non-empty guard the mirrored fill_policy block already has -- a document with a non-string cash_flow_policy value (e.g. an int) would crash validate_params with an unhandled TypeError (via _resolved_cash_flow_policy_path's os.path.isabs) instead of refusing cleanly with a ConfigError, violating dskit/pipeline/CLAUDE.md's own 'errors accumulate, never raise on the first' invariant. Minor: the malformed-type case was missing from the Required Phase-0 matrix as its own row. Nit: an imprecise claim that CashFlowPolicy was imported rather than defined in the file. All three fixed in place before RED; a one-clause fix, not a redesign, so no second fresh Phase-0 round was needed

reuse_confirmed.method: dedicated, exhaustive sweep prompted by a direct owner question ('is the wiring done for a real backtest once real data is available') -- repo-wide grep for every cash_flow_policy reference, every NODE_KINDS registration across all three files in this child that declare one, and replay.py's full git log
reuse_confirmed.findings: confirmed DevelopmentReplay (the only replay-capable pipeline Node, registered as intraday_equities-development-replay) had never been touched by ADR-0176/0177/0178 -- its run() method never passed cash_flow_policy to ReplayAdapter, so a pipeline-document-driven replay got none of that work regardless of document configuration. This ADR closes exactly that gap, wiring the already-built, already-closed EquityReplay/ReplayAdapter/CashFlowPolicy capability into the one entry point a real python -m dskit.pipeline run invocation would actually use

candidate_commits: 2b45189 (Phase-0 clean, GO for RED, 1 Major + 1 Minor + 1 Nit fixed)
matrix_completion.implementation_correction: none needed after Phase-0 approval -- the candidate matches the frozen Decision points 1-3 exactly, confirmed by both final-review lenses against the diff since Phase-0 approval, including that the type-guard fix's ORDER (before the path-exists check) was preserved correctly, not merely its presence
rows_closed: regression baseline: the shipped run-development-replay.json-shaped params dict (no cash-flow keys) validates and runs byte-identically to pre-ADR-0179 behavior -- a genuine json.dumps equality proof against an independently constructed ReplayAdapter(FillPolicy...) call, not a smoke test
XOR refusal: cash_flow_policy present without cash_flow_policy_sha256 (and the converse) refuses naming both
malformed-type refusal (the row added specifically for the Major finding): cash_flow_policy as int/list/empty-string refuses with a clean ConfigError naming cash_flow_policy, never a raw TypeError
digest-mismatch refusal (including a non-string digest value)

positive wiring proof: the SAME bars/decisions run through the node once with a valid cash-flow pair (refuses insufficient_cash, fills only the affordable qty, output byte-identical to a direct ReplayAdapter(policy, cash_flow_policy) call) and once without the pair (fills the full qty, zero cash-flow refusals) -- isolating the effect to the wiring itself
matrix_completion.disposition: candidate passed both final review lenses clean on the first pass -- 0/0/0/0 from both lenses, a clean sweep

commands.focused_result: 78 passed (65 pre-ADR-0179 + 13 new), confirmed twice for determinism (~67s each run)

two_sequential_clean_final_lenses.notes: independently re-verified every Decision point against git diff 2b45189 2d79a9e rather than trusting the ADR's or commit message's claims: confirmed _PARAMS unedited and the required-param loop stays scoped to it, confirmed the Phase-0 type-guard fix is genuine and in the correct order, confirmed the XOR block's silent-when-both-absent behavior, confirmed _resolved_cash_flow_policy_path mirrors _resolved_fill_policy_path field-for-field, confirmed no dskit/production/* or shipped-document file touched, confirmed role/serving_effect unchanged, confirmed the wiring-proof test isolates the effect via a with/without comparison plus a byte-identical cross-check against direct ReplayAdapter construction

active mutation testing on 5 mutations, all caught by name: removing the type guard entirely, dropping ReplayAdapter's second argument in run(), disabling the XOR check, building CashFlowPolicy unconditionally in __init__, and -- the most precise mutation -- swapping the guard's ORDER (path-exists check before the type guard) to confirm the fix requires correct ordering, not merely the guard's bare presence, which still crashed with a raw TypeError exactly as ADR-0179 predicted. Confirmed no vacuous assertions and confirmed the regression-baseline test is a genuine json.dumps equality proof

non_authority: This slice widens DevelopmentReplay's allowed-params set with two OPTIONAL, paired names and threads an already-built capability through an existing constructor call. No dskit/production module changed. No new capability, registry entry, or uses: site. No change to the shipped configs/run-development-replay.json document, EquityReplay, ReplayAdapter, or CashFlowPolicy themselves -- whether any specific document opts into cash-flow funding for a real run is a separate, later config-only decision this ADR does not make. No ReplayRun/P4 wiring. No backtest launch, no paper/live trading, no deployment.
